hero.title: To the end of the world
hero.subtitle: Apostle Gabriel Olu Akintan is a man called and ordained to preach the gospel and bring men to Christ
hero.verseText: Go therefore and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, and teaching them to obey everything that I have commanded you. And remember, I am with you always, to the end of the age.

aboutPreview: Apostle Gabriel Olu Akintan is the President and Founder of Grace Assembly Ministries in Lagos, Nigeria. He is an Apostle and Teacher of the Word whose ministry is characterised by notable and creative miracles, and a deep commitment to raising a generation of kingdom-minded believers.

aboutSections.heading: Early Life & Call
aboutSections.body: Apostle Gabriel Olu Akintan was born and raised in Lagos, Nigeria, where he experienced a profound encounter with the Lord at a young age. Called from his mother's womb, he began ministering as a teenager and has never looked back.

aboutSections.heading: Education
aboutSections.body: He holds a Bachelor's degree in Theology from the West Africa Theological Seminary and a Master's in Biblical Studies from the University of Lagos. He is also a certified leadership coach and a Fellow of the International Institute of Christian Leaders.

aboutSections.heading: Ordination
aboutSections.body: He was ordained into the ministry in 2008 by Archbishop Amos Akintan and later consecrated as an Apostle in 2015. His apostolic cover spans across Africa, Europe, and North America.

aboutSections.heading: Marriage & Family
aboutSections.body: Apostle Gabriel is happily married to Pastor Grace Akintan, and they are blessed with three children. Together they oversee the Grace Assembly Ministries network which includes over 12 churches across Nigeria.

verses.text: Fear not, for I am with you; be not dismayed, for I am your God; I will strengthen you, I will help you, I will uphold you with my righteous right hand.
Trust in the Lord with all your heart, and do not lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make straight your paths.
I can do all things through him who strengthens me.
